text: dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的本地项目发现插件。它在侧边栏提供发现面板，并注册模型可调用的工具；扫描配置的目录树，识别包含 .git 目录或文件的仓库，显示其注册状态，再通过 DSH workspaceRegistry 将选中的仓库批量加入工作区。面板可调整扫描根目录和深度，也可按名称或路径筛选。适合需要把已有本地代码仓库快速加入 DSH 工作区的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务；扫描和配置都在 DSH 主机本地进行。

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery finds local Git repositories for DSH Web. Its sidebar and model tools scan folders, show registration status, and add selected projects through workspaceRegistry. Users can set scan roots and depth and filter results. No API key or external service is needed.
想把电脑里已有的 Git 项目一次性加入 DSH 工作区
DSH 能扫描本地目录，列出还没注册的代码仓库吗？
我想在网页侧边栏查看并批量添加本地项目
dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery 的功能「发现本地仓库」：在 Web 侧边栏打开发现面板后扫描配置的目录根路径，列出本地 Git 仓库及其已注册状态，并支持按名称或路径筛选。
dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery 的功能「批量注册工作区」：在发现面板选择若干仓库或选择全部未注册项，随后通过 DSH workspaceRegistry 将目录加入工作区；已注册路径不会重复创建。

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

Discover local git repositories and register them as [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) workspaces — all of them, at once, instead of adding folders one by one.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery：DSH's built-in workspace flow has exactly one route: pick a host directory, one at a time. If you keep dozens of repositories on one machine (under `~/dev`, `~/Documents`, …), most of them never show up in the sidebar simply because nobody registered them. This plugin closes that gap, the way Hermes Agent's workspace picker does with its `repo_scan_roots` discovery:

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery：- **Scan** configurable roots for git repositories (`.git` directory, or a `.git` file for worktrees/submodules).
- **Review** what was found in a sidebar panel: which repositories are already workspaces and which are not, with search, select-all and per-row checkboxes.
- **Register** the selected ones — or all unregistered ones — through the official `workspaceRegistry` API. Registration is idempotent per directory, so re-running a scan never creates duplicates.
- Or let the agent do it: the model-facing tools `workspace_discover` and `workspace_register_discovered` expose the same operations inside a conversation.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery：Nothing is registered automatically unless you opt in (`autoRegister`), no `git` subprocess is ever spawned, and no workspace file is written directly — the plugin only drives the official registry, so uninstalling it leaves every workspace exactly as it was.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery
```

Then restart the web profile and refresh the page. From a local checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/2001Y/dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery
```

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Use：Click **Discover projects** at the bottom of the sidebar (the badge shows how many unregistered repositories were found). In the panel:

1. Adjust the **scan roots** if needed (one absolute path per line) and the max depth, then **Save**.
2. **Scan** (or Rescan) and review the list. Registered repositories are badged and cannot be selected again.
3. **Register selected**, or **Register all unregistered**.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Configuration：Settings live in a host-shared file, `$DSH_HOME/workspace-discovery.config.json`, so every browser hitting the same DSH host shares them. The panel edits this file; a profile patch row can seed initial values:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: workspace-discovery
      name: "dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery"
      config:

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `roots` | `[~]` | Directories to walk. `~` is expanded; relative paths are ignored. |
| `maxDepth` | `4` | How deep below each root to look (0–10). |
| `exclude` | `[]` | Extra directory names to skip, on top of the built-ins (`node_modules`, `.cache`, `.dsh`, `Library`, …). |
| `autoRegister` | `false` | Register every unregistered repository once at startup. Opt-in only. |

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Configuration：Scanning never follows symlinks, never descends into a repository it already found (so nested checkouts are not reported separately), and classifies results against the registry's canonical paths.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Configuration：Two macOS-specific safeguards: when the walk passes through the home directory it does **not** wander into the folders macOS guards with TCC privacy prompts (`Documents`, `Downloads`, `Desktop`, `Pictures`, `Movies`, `Music`, `Library`) — reading those from a background process can block on a consent prompt nobody is there to answer. Name such a folder as a scan root explicitly if you keep repositories there (and grant the DSH host access if macOS asks). And the walk itself runs in a child process with a 25-second per-root timeout, so a blocked or enormous tree costs one root an error entry instead of stalling the Harness.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Model-facing tools：| Tool | Effect |
|---|---|
| `workspace_discover` | Scan and report candidates with a `registered` flag. Read-only. Accepts one-off `roots` / `max_depth` / `only_unregistered`. |
| `workspace_register_discovered` | Register explicit `paths`, or everything unregistered with `all_unregistered: true`. |

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Internationalization：The panel UI ships in **English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese** (`locale/`), follows the language DSH is displaying, and the dictionaries are kept key-identical by tests. Tool names and the JSON contract stay English so callers can match on them reliably.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · How it works：- `index.js` — Cordis host plugin. Requires `workspaceRegistry` and `tools`; mounts HTTP routes only when a `webServer` service exists.
- `src/scan.js` — the filesystem walk (pure, subprocess-free).
- `src/discovery.js` — scan + classify + register, shared by routes and tools.
- `src/config.js` — config sanitizing and the host-shared JSON file.
- `client/` — the browser bundle (`src.js` is the source; `client.js` is built from it with `npm run build`, inlining the locale dictionaries).
dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · How it works：Zero runtime dependencies. Requires Node.js ≥ 20 and DSH 0.2.x.

dsh-plugin-workspace-discovery README · Development：```sh
npm test   # builds the client bundle, then runs node --test
```
